slots.name: inheritance tax rate
slots.sentence: Under the current system, inheritance tax of 40% is paid when someone's estate - the total value of their money and property - exceeds £325,000.

slots.name: couple tax free threshold
slots.sentence: And, when a person dies, they can currently transfer this tax-free allowance to a surviving spouse or civil partner which increases the combined threshold for a couple to £650,000.

slots.name: residence nil rate band
slots.sentence: On top of this individuals can get an additional transferable allowance for a family home of £175,000 each when it is left to children or other direct descendants.

slots.name: max couple tax free allowance
slots.sentence: So at present most married couples can potentially leave £1m without paying inheritance tax.
